title: A smooth map of affine schemes descends to a smooth map of finite type Z-schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a smooth morphism f : X -> S of affine schemes, the lemma produces the Noetherian approximation diagram of the base chapter (cartesian squares with S_0 of finite type over Z and X_0 -> S_0 of finite type) with the extra feature that f_0 is smooth. The retained proof is a written translation-then-approximation: writing S = Spec A and X = Spec B, smoothness of f makes B a smooth A-algebra by the morphisms characterization lemma, and the Algebra chapter's finite-presentation approximation lemma for smooth algebras over Noetherian bases supplies the diagram. Retained author proof at lines 9835-9842.
